message.content:
Los Angeles is **9 hours behind** Berlin.  
So when it’s 12:00 pm (noon) in Berlin, it’s 3:00 am the same day in Los Angeles.  
Both cities observe daylight‑saving time, but the offset stays the same (UTC‑8/UTC‑7 vs. UTC+1/UTC+2), so the 9‑hour difference holds year‑round.
